rooms.name: busy-open-plan
rooms.description: A busy open-plan room, 6 × 5 m, with ten pieces of furniture: a living area (sofa, two armchairs, a coffee table and a TV unit), two bookcases on the back wall, a dining table under a linear pendant, a kitchen island and a desk. Nine luminaires: seven downlights, the pendant (Finelite HP-2) and a wall washer (Lightolier) on the back wall beside the bookcases. Finishes from walnut (0.15) to white (0.8). Measures how accuracy and time scale with a full room.

rooms.name: dark-room
rooms.description: Four downlights on a grid in a dark room: every surface reflects 20 %. Little light bounces, so the light on the work plane is mostly direct.

rooms.name: downlights-and-wall-washer
rooms.description: Four downlights on a grid, and a wall washer (Lightolier, asymmetric) 0.5 m from the wall at x = −2.5, its beam turned onto that wall.

rooms.name: furnished-living
rooms.description: A furnished living room: four downlights over a sofa, a coffee table, a dining table and a bookcase, which block and reflect light as their finishes do (linen 0.55, oak 0.45). Measures what furniture does to light, bounced light included.

rooms.name: linear-pendant-over-table
rooms.description: A 1.2 m direct/indirect linear pendant (Finelite HP-2) at 1.55 m over a 1.6 × 0.9 m oak table top, lengthwise along it: close to a large luminaire, with a shadow on the floor and light on the ceiling.

rooms.name: single-downlight
rooms.description: One 6-inch recessed downlight (Cooper, 1153 lm, a 15 cm disk) in the middle of a 5 × 4 × 2.7 m room, aimed straight down.

rooms.name: small-bathroom
rooms.description: A small bathroom, 2 × 1.6 × 2.4 m, tiled (floor 0.4, walls 0.7): a downlight, and an up/down wall light over the mirror on the left wall, its box centred 25 cm out. Everything is close to everything, so the 25 cm patches and 10 cm cells are large for it.

rooms.name: tall-hall
rooms.description: A tall hall, 8 × 6 × 5 m, lit by six 1.2 m direct/indirect linear pendants (Finelite HP-2) hung at 3.5 m, in two rows: much of their light goes up to the ceiling first. A larger room, with patches far from everything.

rooms.name: track-spots
rooms.description: Two narrow track spots (iGuzzini Palco, 17° beam, 2913 lm) hung at 2.5 m, tilted and panned: one onto the floor towards the wall at z = −2, one onto the wall at x = −2.5.

rooms.name: wall-sconce
rooms.description: An up/down wall sconce (Visa Colonnade, a 23 × 13 × 51 cm glowing box) on the wall at x = −2.5, the box centred 0.25 m out from it at 1.8 m: very close to the wall behind it.

rooms.name: wall-wash
rooms.description: Four narrow track spots (iGuzzini Palco, 17°) tilted 80° from straight down, each onto a wall just below the ceiling: the work plane and the floor get almost only light that has bounced.

rooms.name: white-room
rooms.description: The same four downlights in a white room: every surface reflects 90 %, so most of the light on the work plane has bounced, many times. Radiance follows 72 bounces here, leaving out 0.9⁷² ≈ 0.05 % of it.
